note: Bridger-Teton NF campground in pines and aspens near Cottonwood Lake in the Salt River Range, about 14 mi from Afton on a narrow gravel road (FS 10208). The west loop holds six horse sites with hitching rails and corrals; ATVs may ride through the east loop to a motorized trail. Small boats only, no ramp. After the season closes the gate stays open and camping is free with no services. --Claude
summary: FS page + rec.gov read: 18 sites, FCFS only (no rec.gov listing for singles; group site 13 is on rec.gov 234519), 14-day limit, vault toilets, hand-pump water in the east loop (FS amenity line says none - text and rec.gov say yes). Facilities and booking written; note rewritten. Horse sites on the west loop (question for AWH); ATV trail from the east loop (OHV-side caveat). Fees and rig length left as stored - see flags.
flags: HORSE QUESTION (not dropped): FS 'On the west loop, 6 sites have hitching rails for horses, and three small pipe-rail horse corrals are provided.' The east loop is the general/ATV loop (rec.gov: 'The west loop of the campground includes horse corrals. The east side ... includes the motorized trail head'). Imagery shows the two loops on separate branches of a Y. Whether the west loop also holds non-horse sites mixed with the six horse sites is not stated - if it does, AWH's separation rule says drop; if the west loop is the horse loop, keep.
OHV SIDE: 'ATVs are allowed [in the east loop] because a trail allowing motorized use takes off from the back of the loop' - general campground with an OHV side, caveat written in the note.
